name: Zaure Official Store
bio: This is our store — the one we check every morning before anything else. Featured products, hand-picked deals, and trusted services from across Nigeria, all in one place. If you're new to Zaure, start here. Everything you see has been chosen by us personally.

policies.returns: 7-day returns on any item that doesn't match its description. We cover return shipping.
policies.shipping: Nationwide delivery in 2–5 business days. Free shipping on orders over ₦50,000.
policies.warranty: Full buyer protection on every order placed through Zaure Official. We stand behind every product.

name: El
bio: El started with a simple idea: everyday things deserve to be made well. Shoe polish that actually protects. Shampoo that actually cleans. Products built for Nigerian leather, Nigerian hair, Nigerian weather. One name. Every detail.

policies.returns: 14-day returns accepted if the product is unopened and in original packaging.
policies.shipping: Dispatched within 24 hours. Delivery in 2–4 days across Nigeria.
policies.warranty: Every El product is guaranteed against manufacturing defects. Contact us and we'll make it right.

name: Teema Kitchenwares
bio: We're a small Kaduna family business that takes kitchenware seriously. Glass jugs that don't crack, cookware that lasts, and the everyday tools that make cooking easier. Every item is one we'd use ourselves. Delivered carefully across Northern Nigeria — most of our customers come back a second time.

policies.returns: Returns accepted within 3 days if the item arrives damaged. Send us a photo and we'll replace it.
policies.shipping: Careful packaging and hand delivery within Kaduna. Courier to Abuja, Kano, and Jos in 2–3 days.
policies.warranty: All glassware is inspected before dispatch. If anything arrives cracked, we replace it free.
